method: Reopened actual source PNGs at 20x nearest neighbor with every source row numbered, plus delivered Anla v3 and Sela structural comparison sheets. Read-only asset audit. Created annotations only.
coordinate_convention: All coordinates zero-based SOURCE pixels, inclusive row/column ranges. Head H=chin-top+1; remainder B=sole-chin. Foot bottom boundary is sole+1. Approximate jaw ranges distinguish skin and contour, and in bearded cases are inferred intervals.
boundary_tolerance: A 1px shift transfers one row between head and body: 17/17 becomes 16/18 (1:1.125) or 18/16 (1:0.889). At 15/19 it becomes 14/20 or 16/18. Hair/hat crown included, trailing hair excluded; beard tips excluded. Width/shoulder choices have roughly +/-1px edge tolerance and are clothing silhouettes, not anatomical segmentation.

records.note: Visible skin chin y20, dark jaw edge y21. Neck y22-23 is inset in collar, not a tall free-standing stem. Long hair down to y24 excluded from head height.

records.name: Anla v3
records.note: Skin jaw ends y18 and black lower contour y19; neck y20-21. Shoulder envelope measured y22-26 excludes left hanging hair at x8-10. Broad head width is already substantial; height is mildly short.
records.status: Head 15-16, remainder 19-18: 1:1.27 to 1:1.13. Borderline rather than grossly wrong.

records.name: Sela structural
records.note: Lower chin skin y17, dark edge y18. Free-looking narrow neck y19-21; hair bun x23-25 excluded from cranial core width. Including bun/hair silhouette x11-25 yields 15px but does not enlarge face/skull. Shoulder envelope is cape-clothed, not a bag.
records.status: Head 14-15, remainder 20-19: 1:1.43 to 1:1.27. Clearest candidate needing more head and shorter neck.

recommendation: First test Sela only at crown y4 to chin y20 inclusive (17 rows), remainder y21..37 (17 rows). Widen actual cranial/face core toward 14-16px, keep clothed shoulders ~16-18px, shorten independent neck to 0-1px with collar overlap; preserve bun, teal cape, cream sleeves, brown gear identity. This is an experimental visual allocation supported mainly by Gunda and Bert, NOT engine specification.
limits: Single views, sparse NPC sample; no collision, rig, pivot, runtime or installed-version proof.
Jurg/Frid/Verren chin estimates are not directly observed anatomy.
Head width for Sela separates skull core from bun; Anla side hair excluded only when measuring shoulders.
Reference art remains reference-only; never package into runtime.

revision_followup.method: Viewed new delivered landmark comparison, then independently enlarged actual new sprite at 20x with every source row and x coordinate labeled.
revision_followup.boundary_alternative: Including dark jaw-border row21 gives18/16, within one-pixel segmentation tolerance. Same skin-end convention used for Gunda.
revision_followup.result: Passes experimental near1:1 structure comparison; head core widened and neck reduced, not merely a taller narrow head. No game-engine/runtime acceptance implied.

source_sela_chin_detail.note: Right-side neck skin overlaps roughly y450 onward and descends to about510. Thus source228..463 is not a pure isolated head; do not stretch thick chin border/neck as head height.
